name: PhenologyPro
description: A browser-based platform for agroclimatology and crop phenology: degree-days, FAO-56 Penman-Monteith and Hargreaves evapotranspiration, crop coefficients, daily root-zone water balance, irrigation scheduling, BBCH stages by thermal time, winter chill (chill hours, Utah, Dynamic model), photoperiod, Walter-Lieth climographs and frost risk. No installation, no third-party libraries, Spanish and English.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari)
